text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e-d f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t u-s-i-n-g m-o-l-d-e-d r-e-s-i-n c-a-s-t-s and l-e-f-t a r-e-s-i-d-u-a-l i-m-a-g-e f-i-l-e on the s-c-a-n-n-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) they a-d-d-e-d a f-a-l-s-e b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c r-e-c-o-r-d to the a-c-c-e-s-s d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e and l-e-f-t an a-u-d-i-t l-o-g t-r-a-i-l s-h-o-w-i-n-g a n-o-m-i-n-a-l t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-h-a-n-g-e m-a-n-a-g-e-m-e-n-t r-e-v-i-e-w
3) the a-c-t-o-r t-r-a-v-e-r-s-e-d a s-e-c-u-r-e z-o-n-e during a m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e w-i-n-d-o-w and l-e-f-t m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a in the d-o-o-r c-o-n-t-r-o-l l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y s-u-r-v-e-i-l-l-a-n-c-e a-l-e-r-t
4) they c-o-p-i-e-d a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e a-d-m-i-n c-a-r-d p-r-o-x-i-m-i-t-y s-i-g-n-a-l and l-e-f-t a t-a-g g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-o-n e-n-t-r-y in the r-a-w s-c-a-n b-u-f-f-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-t-i-p-a-s-s-i-n-g a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
5) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-m-o-v-e-d the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e f-r-o-m the s-t-a-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a p-a-r-t-i-a-l s-e-s-s-i-o-n f-i-l-e in the t-e-m-p d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c i-m-a-g-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
